description: This file defines an Android Fragment, 'OtherMetadataFragment', demonstrating how to attach and manage metadata (such as priority, category, and person data) in Android notifications. It includes methods for creating notifications with specific metadata, handling contact selection to add person data, and updating UI elements related to notification metadata.

classes.name: OtherMetadataFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates attaching metadata (priority, category, contact info) to notifications.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI references and event handlers after view creation.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates a Notification object with specified priority, category, and contact URI.

methods.name: showNotificationClicked
methods.description: Handles the button click to show a notification with current selections.

methods.name: loadBitmapFromContactUri
methods.description: Loads contact photo as Bitmap from Uri.

methods.name: updateContactEntryFromUri
methods.description: Updates UI with contact info based on selected contact Uri.
